propositions: Documentation for tri-state file-impact declaration (undeclared, paths, none) is fragmented across four reader-facing locations and lacks a complete, coherent author contract

Public runtime entry point `rebar explain plan` does not communicate the none command, advisory no-file-impact review criterion, or the reason-field semantics required for authors to complete none declarations

The authoritative semantics for FILE_IMPACT event replacement and field-clearing rules across all three states are documented only in implementation code and not in standalone, auditable documentation

Four documentation locations must agree on undeclared/paths/none semantics, state-transition effects, container freshness and roll-up behavior, and the docs-only/test-only convention without requiring source-grep or snapshot tests

A public CLI behavior test must verify that `rebar explain plan` communicates all tri-state choices, the set-file-impact command, and the reason-field guidance, independent of private implementation or exact prose
